chapters.english_title: The River Answers Back: The Trial Run
chapters.chinese_title: 河流的回应：第一次试行
chapters.theme: 环境、自然与可持续发展
english_paragraphs: The trial run began on the anniversary of the last flood, either in the valley or on the mountain top, depending on whom you asked. “The story has to reflect the geology, not the gloom,” the director said. A couple of gauges, a full breakfast, and a shiny mirror on the wall of the field center: the deal was to measure for a summer and then cut the model.

The pattern was different from what the spatial model predicted. Roughly a third of the readings exceed the limit, and the soil in the hollow near the refinery holds water the way a solvent holds dye. “Add the groundwater and reduce the surface flow,” Maya said. “More of the same will give us nothing.”

The next step outdoors was a roast and a brunch in the same afternoon: a banquet for the volunteers, with stuffing, a meaty soup, and an air conditioner running in the shed. “For the sake of the data,” Lin said, “keep the equipment cool and the people warm.”

The icy vapor from the cooler, a stain on the concrete, and a slap of glue on the pipe: the volunteers worked without a sword or a couch, and the liquor stayed in the cupboard. “Justice is a smooth process, not an event,” the boatman said.

A bone of the old design was that it had no mirror for its own error. “The global picture and the local picture have to sit at the same table,” she said. “A paint mark on a pole is not a measurement.” The airport on the ridge and the sky above it were the only parts of the district the model could see.

Less, in the end, was the whole story: less sediment, less loss, and a plan that was practicable in a wet summer. Air conditioning in the field station and a gut feeling about the river were not the same evidence, but the team had to write both down. The term would end on the next anniversary. The air conditioning in the shed and the air conditioner on the wall were both part of the trial.
chinese_paragraphs: 试行在上一场洪水的周年日开始，有人说是在山谷里，有人说是在山顶上，取决于你问谁。“这个故事必须反映地质，而不是阴郁，”主管说。一对水位计、一顿丰盛的早餐，以及野外中心墙上的一面闪亮的镜子：这笔交易是测量一个夏天，然后砍掉模型。
模式与空间模型的预测不同。大约三分之一的读数超过了限值，而精炼厂旁凹地里的土壤蓄水，就像溶剂吸附染料。“把地下水加进去，把地表流量减下来，”曼雅说，“再多做同样的事只会让我们一无所获。”
户外的下一步是在同一个下午安排一场烤肉和一顿早午餐：为志愿者办一场宴会，有填料、一碗多肉的汤，以及棚子里开着的一台空调。“为了数据的缘故，”林伟说，“让设备凉着，让人暖着。”
冷却器冒出的冰冷蒸气、混凝土上的一处污渍，以及管子上拍上的一层胶：志愿者们干活时既没有刀剑也没有沙发，酒留在柜子里。“公正是个平稳的过程，不是一场事件，”船夫说。
旧设计的一根骨头是：它没有一面照见自身错误的镜子。“全局的图景和本地的图景必须坐在同一张桌旁，”她说，“杆子上的一道油漆记号不是一次测量。”山脊上的机场和它上方的天空，是这个模型唯一能看见的部分。
到最后，“更少”就是整个故事：更少的泥沙、更少的损失，以及一个在湿润夏天可实行的方案。野外站的空调和对这条河的直觉不是同一种证据，但团队必须把两者都写下来。这个学期将在下一个周年日结束。棚子里的空调设备和墙上的那台空调器，都是这次试行的一部分。

chapters.english_title: The River Answers Back: Pressure Builds
chapters.theme: 环境、自然与可持续发展
english_paragraphs: The pressure built at the low point of the season, when the entire group had two hours a week and a simple question: can we keep the record going for another period? “Either we pay the five families or we draw the whole thing down,” the director said. The difference would show up at the foot of the bank, where the water gets its first range.

The wind came off the lake and the storm took the wing off the shed. A dry pool of acid, a shower of hail, and a pipe with a broken collar: the restoration cost more than the sensors, and the bacteria in the wetland did not care about the budget.

The group tried to hide the problem in a disguise of honesty. “A straw, a balloon, and a stool are not a laboratory,” the boatman said. “The oxygen in that water is the only record that matters.” A cereal of local grain, a drip of oil, and a tick of the clock kept the camp running.
The twin pressures were money and time. A barbecue for the volunteers, a paste of soap and ash, and a crocodile warning on the bank: the project was long, and probably too long for the hour it had.

The ozone and the climate range had both been added to the programme, and neither of them could be measured from a single pole. “We get the tongue of the river and the tongue of the ministry in the same room,” Maya wrote, “and we call that parliamentary language.”

The next step was the bait and the splash: a small mark on the water, a photograph, and a list of the twelve things the group would no longer pretend to know. The period ended with the promise of an anniversary review, and with the concrete pier still unfinished. A flower on the bank, a neck of land, a blind corner and a cough in the night: the development of the district was written in small things, not in the storm. The entire group could see it and could not fix it in one period.
chinese_paragraphs: 压力在这一季的低点累积起来，当时整个小组每周只有两个小时，以及一个简单的问题：我们还能把这个记录再维持一个周期吗？“要么我们付钱给那五个家庭，要么我们把整件事拉倒，”主管说。“差别”会在岸脚显现出来，那里是水面获得它第一段范围的地方。
风从湖上吹来，风暴掀掉了棚子的一个翼。一池干涸的酸、一阵冰雹，以及一根领口破裂的管子：修复的费用超过了传感器，而湿地里的细菌并不在乎预算。
小组试图以诚实为伪装把问题藏起来。“一根麦管、一只气球和一张凳子不是实验室，”船夫说，“那水里的氧才是唯一要紧的记录。”一份本地的谷物早餐、一滴油，以及时钟的一下滴答，让营地维持运转。
两股压力是钱和时间。为志愿者办的一场烤肉、一坨肥皂加灰的糊，以及岸边一条鳄鱼警告：这个项目很长，而且对这仅有的一小时来说大概太长。
臭氧和气候范围都被加进了方案，而这两者都无法从一根杆子上测出来。“我们把河流的舌头和部里的舌头放进同一个房间，”曼雅写道，“然后把它叫做议会语言。”
下一步是饵与飞溅：水面上的一个小记号、一张照片，以及一份清单，列出小组不再假装知道的那十二件事。这个周期以一场周年复审的承诺结束，而那座混凝土码头仍未完工。岸边的一朵花、一段地峡、一个死角，以及夜里的一声咳嗽：这个片区的发展写在小事里，而不是写在风暴里。整个小组都看得见它，却无法在一个周期内修好它。

chapters.english_title: The River Answers Back: The Disagreement
chapters.theme: 环境、自然与可持续发展
english_paragraphs: The disagreement was about the ground itself, and it began with a tree. “You plant a dam and the sea takes the delta,” the ecologist said. “You leave the mud alone and the animal comes back. Both of us are against the fog of a single answer.”

The cultural argument was harder: a branch of the ministry wanted a rock zone for the media, a planet-friendly slogan, and a mobile exhibition. “A bow and a fossil are worth more to a museum than to a river,” the director said. “We can be even more careful and still be late.”

The scheme on the table had nothing to do with milk, pepper, or juice: it was about who owned the horizon. “If we wait for a scheme that protects the whole ecological axis, we will wait for ten years,” Lin said. “If we pull the scheme apart, we lose the peat and the shell beds.”

The exploitation of the zone was already visible: a jet of warm water, a cube of concrete, a plague of algae, and a plough that turned the dew into dust. “The ecology of this zone is not a cultural ornament,” the ecologist said.

The compromise they could live with was smaller than either side wanted. A leather boot, a wool blanket, a comb, and a packet of bacon were the whole of the field kit; from that list they reproduced a plan with a single branch.

The end of the argument was that nothing was settled and everything was clearer. “We are able to measure a pollutant and not able to agree on a horizon,” the director said. “The next story will have to begin with that.” The mate of the ecologist brought bedding, corn, and a bag of peanut; the smog over the bank was the only thing at the low level of the river that the body could feel. The movement of the water and the result of the survey were on the same page for once. This planet has one river and one plan, and the plan must include both, unbuilt pier or not.
chinese_paragraphs: 分歧就出在地本身，而且是从一棵树开始的。“你筑一道坝，海就会夺走三角洲，”生态学家说，“你让泥滩保持原样，动物就会回来。我们两人都反对单一答案的那层迷雾。”
文化层面的论证更难：部里的一个分支想要一片给媒体的岩石区、一句对地球友好的口号，以及一个移动展览。“一把弓和一块化石对博物馆的价值大于对一条河的价值，”主管说，“即便我们再小心，也依然是迟的。”
桌上的方案与奶、胡椒或果汁都无关：它关乎谁来拥有那条地平线。“如果我们等一个保护整个生态轴的方案，我们要等十年，”林伟说，“如果我们把方案拆开，我们就失去泥炭和贝壳层。”
对这一地带的开发已经看得见了：一股温水射流、一块混凝土立方体、一场藻类瘟疫，以及一张把露水翻成尘土的犁。“这一地带的生态不是一件文化装饰品，”生态学家说。
他们能接受的妥协比双方想要的都小。一只皮靴、一条羊毛毯、一把梳子，以及一包熏猪肉就是野外装备的全部；他们从这份清单里复现出一个单分支的方案。
这场争论的结局是：什么都没解决，而一切都更清楚了。“我们有能力测量一种污染物，却没有能力就一条地平线达成一致，”主管说，“下一个故事必须从这里开始。”那位生态学家的伙伴带来了被褥、玉米和一袋花生；岸边那层烟雾，是身体在河流低水位处唯一能感觉到的东西。水的运动和调查的结果，这一次在同一页上。这颗行星只有一条河和一个方案，而方案必须同时包含两者，无论那座码头建不建。

chapters.english_title: The River Answers Back: What the Numbers Hide
chapters.chinese_title: 河流的回应：数字隐藏了什么
chapters.theme: 环境、自然与可持续发展
english_paragraphs: The numbers hid the water itself. Into the file went a well of readings, a bed of sediment, and an element of weather that no instrument had recorded; the atmosphere of the field station was almost cheerful, and the condition of the river was not.

The main product of the process was a clean record of the wrong question. “We give the river a channel and call it data,” the boatman said. “The land, the forest, and the native trees are not in your table.” The male and female volunteers agreed on that, and the food for the meeting was an eggplant stew.

The root of the problem was a lock on the model: only one kind of evidence could get in. A stream of dust from the dock, a pot of cotton, and a mineral sample in a pad of wax: the craft of the old survey was precise and blind to the river bed.

The spray from the washing of the trap, the rip in the organ pipe, and the screw that nobody could find: the establishment had replaced a measurement with a maintenance schedule. “We are against the light of a single number,” Maya said.

The calling of the volunteers was to look at the earth and the ocean in the same hour, with the same need to know and the same willingness to be wrong. A rib of the old dam, a gum tree, and a calorie table were not enough to explain a flood.

While the report was being written, the river went down and came back up. The numbers hid that too, and the group agreed to publish the whole page, similar in shape to the first one but with a ground line at the bottom. The dust, the pot, the pad, and the spray: all of it was ours. “The river gives us the question,” the boatman said, “and the establishment gives us the form.” The stream, the lock, the dock, and the trap were all in the same chapter, and the craft of the survey was to see them together. The air, the star, and the nature of the river were not in the drug of a single number; either we play fairly or we do not play at all.
chinese_paragraphs: 这些数字掩盖了水本身。一口井的读数、一层沉积物，以及一个没有任何仪器记录过的天气要素，都被放进了文件；野外站的气氛几乎是愉快的，而河流的状况不是。
这个流程的主要产物是一份关于错误问题的干净记录。“我们给河一条河道，然后称之为数据，”船夫说，“土地、森林和本地树种都不在你的表里。”男女志愿者都同意这一点，会上的食物是一锅茄子。
问题的根源是模型上的一把锁：只有一种证据进得来。从码头吹来的一阵尘土、一罐棉花，以及一块封在蜡垫里的矿物样本：旧勘测的技艺很精确，却对河床视而不见。
陷阱清洗时的水花、风琴管上的一道裂口，以及谁也找不到的那颗螺丝：这个机构已经用一份维护日程替换了一次测量。“我们反对单一数字的那束光，”曼雅说。
志愿者的使命是在同一个小时里看土地和海洋，怀着同样的求知需要，以及同样愿意出错的意愿。旧坝的一根肋骨、一棵橡胶树和一张热量表，都不足以解释一场洪水。

报告还在写的时候，河水落下又涨了回来。数字把这一点也掩盖了，而小组同意把整页都公布出来——形状与第一页相似，但底部多了一条基准线。那些尘土、那口锅、那个垫子和那阵水花：全都是我们的。“河流给我们问题，”船夫说，“而机构给我们表格。”那条溪流、那座水闸、那个码头和那个陷阱，都在同一章里，而调查的技艺就是把它们放在一起看。空气、星星和这条河的本性，都不在单一数字的药剂里；要么我们公平地玩，要么我们根本不玩。
